The product would probably work better if the moisturizer being used had ingredients that allowed the hyaluronic acid property to be fully utilized. I am now using the serum every night and results are more obvious with consistent use. If you rub the serum between your fingers, it has a very slippery feel to it. It glides effortlessly onto my skin, almost like a barrier. It sinks in incredibly fast to the point of looking like nothing was applied in the first place. This helps to move on with your skincare regimen or even your day quicker. It's not sticky or greasy, which is great. It doesn't affect my oily t-zone problems and still manages to help the rest of my skin that's generally dehydrated. I find that 6-7 drops are enough to thoroughly cover my entire face and neck area.
